title: It's rigid and thick
text: It's rigid and thick. Great quality and lots of options on how to use it.  But, I find that the pad is generally very rigid and a bit too thick.  If you need extreme lumbar support, then this might work great for you.  I found that the cooling gel pad moved around too much so I don't ever use that.  But otherwise the construction quality is very respectable, just wish that it wasn't quite so thick.
